features.title: Features
features.intro: Everything you need to turn a raw chapter into a readable translation — and to fix what the AI gets wrong.

sections.h: Made for manga, manhwa and manhua
p: Translate Chinese, Korean and Japanese pages into Vietnamese or English. The current list of languages is always shown on the pricing page.
Clean mode removes the original text and reconstructs the artwork behind it.
Overlay mode covers the original text with a matching box. It is faster and works well for simple bubbles.
Add terms like character names, titles or places as “source = target” lines so they are translated the same way on every page.
Upload PNG, JPG or WebP pages, or a ZIP/CBZ archive. Download the finished chapter as ZIP or CBZ.
Pages are flagged when text recognition is uncertain, the translation may be wrong, or text does not fit its bubble.
In the editor you can fix the translation, move or resize text boxes, and change font size, alignment, colour, outline and capitalisation. Re-typesetting is free.
Machine translation makes mistakes, especially with slang, puns, stylised sound effects and handwriting. Always review a chapter before sharing it.
Uploaded pages and results are deleted automatically after the retention period shown on the pricing page. You can also delete a job at any time.

items.a: No. The AI is good at typical dialogue but can make mistakes with slang, jokes, names and stylised text. Pages that look uncertain are flagged for review, and you can correct any bubble in the editor.
PNG, JPG, JPEG and WebP images, or ZIP and CBZ archives containing them. The size and page limits are shown on the pricing page.

items.q: How much does a page cost?
items.a: Each translated page costs credits; the exact amount for each mode is on the pricing page. You are only charged for pages that render successfully.

items.q: What is the difference between clean and overlay mode?
items.a: Clean mode removes the original text and repaints the background. Overlay mode places a box over the original text — faster, and fine for plain bubbles.

items.q: How long are my files kept?
items.a: Uploads and results are deleted automatically after the retention period listed on the pricing page. Download your chapters before then.

items.q: Can I translate any manga I find online?
items.a: Only if you own the content or have permission from the rights holder. Uploading content you do not have rights to is not allowed under our Terms.
As soon as the payment provider confirms the payment. This is usually quick, but can take a few minutes.

items.q: Can I fix a translation after the job finishes?
items.a: Yes. Open the editor from the job page, change the text or layout, and save. The page is re-typeset for free.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of MangaTranslate AI (“the service”). By creating an account or using the service you agree to them.

p: MangaTranslate AI uses automated tools to detect, translate, remove and re-letter text in comic pages you upload. Results are generated by machine and may contain errors. You are responsible for reviewing results before using or sharing them.
You must own, or have all necessary rights and permissions from the rights holder for, any content you upload, process or translate with the service.
Do not upload content you do not have the rights to. You keep ownership of your content. You give us a limited permission to store and process it only to provide the service to you.
You may not use the service for illegal content, content that infringes others’ rights, sexual content involving minors, malware, or attempts to disrupt or circumvent the service and its limits.

Translations are paid for with credits. Prices and credit costs are shown on the pricing page. Purchased credits are added after the payment provider confirms payment. Credits are charged only for pages that render successfully.
Refund requests are handled case by case and as required by applicable law.
Uploaded files and results are deleted automatically after the retention period shown on the pricing page. Keep your own copies of anything you need.
We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

The service is provided “as is” without warranties of accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
We may update these terms and will show the new version on this page. For copyright or abuse reports, contact abuse@example.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data MangaTranslate AI processes and why.

p: Account data: your email address, password (stored in hashed form), language preference and role.
Content: the pages you upload, the text recognised in them, translations and generated images.
Billing: payment records such as amount, status and the payment provider’s reference. Card or bank details are handled by the payment provider, not by us.
Technical data: IP address and browser information used for security, rate limiting and abuse prevention.
To run your translation jobs, keep your account secure, process payments, send service emails (such as verification and password reset) and prevent abuse.
To translate your pages, images and extracted text are sent to third-party text-recognition and translation providers. They are used only to process your job.

Uploaded files and results are deleted after the retention period shown on the pricing page. Account data is kept while your account exists. Accounting and payment records are kept for as long as the law requires, even after account deletion.
We use an essential session cookie to keep you logged in and a cookie that remembers your language. We do not use advertising cookies.
You can change your language, change your password or delete your account in Settings. Deleting your account removes your files and personal data, except records we must keep by law.

copyright.title: Copyright & abuse
copyright.intro: We respect the rights of creators. Users may only upload content they own or have permission to translate.

p: If you believe content processed with our service infringes your copyright, email abuse@example.com with: a description of the copyrighted work; where the infringing material is (for example a link or job reference, if known); your name and contact details; a statement that you believe in good faith the use is not authorised; and a statement that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the rights holder or authorised to act for them, with your signature.

We review every notice, remove or disable access to infringing material where appropriate, and may suspend accounts of repeat infringers. If your content was removed and you believe this was a mistake, you can reply with a counter-notice to the same address.
To report illegal content or other misuse of the service, also contact abuse@example.com.
The example images on our homepage are from Pepper&Carrot by David Revoy, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC-BY 4.0).
